card.name: Section cross-references in highlights lists
card.fires_on: Opening brackets, parentheses, spaces or digits that start a section number or tag right after a sentence ends, as in '(5.4)' or '[Priority 1]'. Also the '(N' in plant native-status codes.

modes.label: Section number reference
modes.description: Opening parenthesis or space just before a numbered section cross-reference after a highlights bullet.
modes.example: Initiate appropriate therapy if concomitant skin infections develop.<< (>> 5.4 ) • Flammable

modes.label: Bracketed priority tag
modes.description: Bracket or space before a priority level tag after a web accessibility guideline.
modes.example: 1.1 Provide a text equivalent for every non-text element (e.g., via "alt", "longdesc", or in element content).<< [>>Priority 1] - 3.

modes.label: Plant status code
modes.description: The '(N' in USDA native status codes in plant profiles, before a Water Use rating such as Medium.
modes.example: USDA Native Status: L48<<(N>>), CAN(N) Growing ConditionsWater Use
